today.title: Cruisin' Hines
today.price: Free for spectators; $5 per participating vehicle
today.summary: A stoplight-free classic-car cruise along Hines Drive, limited to vehicles at least 25 years old. It is the best nearby, low-commitment option for browsing vintage cars today.

today.title: She Moves Plymouth
today.registration: Ticket required for the full wellness experience
today.summary: A women-focused community wellness day with a beginner-friendly Pilates class, local and women-owned vendors, food, shopping and social activities in downtown Plymouth.

today.title: Eastern Market Sunday Market
today.summary: The summer Sunday Market emphasizes local craftspeople, art, clothing and apparel rather than the produce-heavy Saturday market. It pairs easily with lunch in the district.

today.title: Detroit Bourbon & Blues Festival
today.summary: An immersive American whiskey tasting event with live blues in Shed 5. A good fit for adults who want a structured afternoon rather than simply browsing Eastern Market.

today.title: Historic Base Ball in Greenfield Village
today.price: Included with Greenfield Village admission; free for members
today.summary: Greenfield Village clubs play town ball using 1867-era rules and presentation. It is a relaxed, unusual afternoon event that can be combined with a Village visit.

today.title: Michigan Renaissance Festival
today.summary: Opening weekend of the 2026 season, with jousting, stage shows, costumed performers, crafts and food across the wooded festival grounds. Allow most of a day and expect heat and crowds.

today.title: Lapeer Days Festival
today.dateLabel: Today; car show 10:00 AM–3:00 PM, carnival noon–6:00 PM
today.price: Free festival admission; carnival rides extra
today.summary: The final day of Michigan's large free community festival includes a classic-car show, juried arts and crafts, entertainment and carnival rides. Worth considering only if a longer drive sounds appealing.

today.title: Armada Fair
today.summary: The closing day of the 154th Armada Fair offers livestock, agricultural exhibits, carnival rides and grandstand entertainment. It is a full-day choice and one of today's farthest drives.

today.title: TLC & Salt-N-Pepa with En Vogue
today.summary: Three defining R&B and hip-hop groups share a co-headlining bill built around 1990s and early-2000s hits. The strongest evening entertainment option if tickets remain available.

easyAnswer: Best easy outing: Cruisin' Hines, about 12 miles away, free for spectators and running 9:00 AM–4:00 PM. For something even closer, She Moves Plymouth runs 11:00 AM–4:00 PM, but it is a ticketed, women-focused wellness event.

planAhead.title: Rush — Fifty Something Tour
planAhead.dateLabel: Wed Aug 26 and Fri Aug 28, 7:30 PM
planAhead.summary: Geddy Lee and Alex Lifeson celebrate more than 50 years of Rush music and honor Neil Peart in two Detroit arena shows.
planAhead.deadline: Check remaining seats now; first show is August 26

planAhead.title: SAW The Musical: The Unauthorized Parody
planAhead.summary: A deliberately campy musical parody of the first Saw movie, making its Detroit stop for three performances.

planAhead.title: Michigan State Fair
planAhead.summary: A close-to-home Labor Day fair with livestock, creative arts, carnival rides, shopping, monster trucks and a demolition derby. Parking is free while space lasts.

planAhead.title: Detroit Jazz Festival
planAhead.price: Free general admission; VIP passes available
planAhead.summary: The major free Labor Day weekend jazz festival returns with four days of national and Detroit artists on multiple downtown stages.

planAhead.title: Jazz on the Trails
planAhead.summary: A one-hour local jazz program along the Lower Rouge Trail. It is the lowest-travel plan-ahead option in this edition.

planAhead.title: Plymouth Fall Festival
planAhead.price: Free admission; food and rides extra
planAhead.summary: Plymouth's signature fall weekend combines nonprofit food booths, carnival rides, a pet show and a full entertainment schedule around Kellogg Park.

planAhead.title: Brews, Brats and Bands
planAhead.summary: A close-to-home outdoor evening built around beer, bratwurst and live bands at Preservation Park.

planAhead.title: Dally in the Alley
planAhead.summary: Detroit's volunteer-run, sponsorship-free street festival fills the Cass Corridor with local music, art, food, beer, vendors and a children's area.

planAhead.title: Eastern Market After Dark
planAhead.summary: The headline night of Detroit Month of Design spreads galleries, open studios, installations, shopping, live music and a Slow Roll ride across Eastern Market.

planAhead.title: Artoberfest
planAhead.summary: A compact local arts event in Cherry Hill Village, useful as an easy Saturday outing without a drive into Detroit.

planAhead.title: Hallowe'en in Greenfield Village
planAhead.registration: Timed ticket required; train and dining experiences cost extra
planAhead.summary: Greenfield Village becomes an after-dark Halloween landscape with more than 1,000 jack-o'-lanterns, costumed characters, performances and optional dining experiences.
planAhead.deadline: Popular timed entries can sell out; reserve early

planAhead.title: Detroit Harvest Fest
planAhead.venue: Ralph C. Wilson Jr. Centennial Park
planAhead.price: $5 advance, $8 at the door; $15 advance family four-pack
planAhead.summary: A full weekend of fall activities, food and entertainment at Detroit's new riverfront park; admission is free for ages 3 and under, 65 and over, and active military.

planAhead.title: Pumpkin Palooza
planAhead.summary: Downtown businesses host a free costumed trick-or-treat stroll with entertainment and costume contests for families and pets.
